subject.title: [Feature] Control UI: Support channel-based session view toggle

question: Should OpenClaw treat current Sessions page channel grouping as sufficient for this request, or add a first-class separated/merged channel timeline toggle?
rationale: Current main provides channel grouping, but the requested merged timeline and separated channel tabs require UX, privacy, routing, and Gateway contract choices that automation should not invent.

options.title: Scope the toggle semantics
options.body: Keep this issue open and define separated view, merged timeline, privacy, routing, and Gateway API behavior before implementation.

options.title: Accept grouping as sufficient
options.body: Close this request if maintainers intentionally do not want a merged or separated transcript-view toggle beyond Sessions grouping.

options.title: Fold into the sessions workspace
options.body: Make #80901 the canonical design issue if channel views should be solved together with peek, inline reply, and status semantics.

recommendation.title: Scope the toggle semantics
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and define separated view, merged timeline, privacy, routing, and Gateway API behavior before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the recent merged Sessions grouping work that most directly overlaps the remaining product decision.
